verdict.rationale: Mintlify's analytics dashboard docs explicitly cover documentation traffic, search queries, engagement, and reader feedback, plus assistant conversations. The REST API can also export analytics data, so all three story elements are claimed first-party. Missing for 10: detail on per-page breakdowns showing which docs succeed or fail, clarity on which insights are limited to the Enterprise 'Advanced insights' tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard.
